summary: No safe narrow repair is available under the requested typed portable-button boundary. The stale prompt is real, but the only existing generic model-turn path is deprecated raw callback value fallback; explicit typed callbacks are intentionally opaque and can silently do nothing when no plugin owns them.

actions.reason: Keep the reproducible issue open while maintainers decide whether to add a first-class model-response presentation action with cross-channel routing semantics.

A safe fix requires product/API direction for a typed model-response action and canonical routing/fallback semantics. Updating shared guidance to opaque typed callbacks is unsafe; directing models to deprecated raw value callbacks conflicts with the requested no-inference portable contract.

needs_human: Decide whether OpenClaw should add a portable, model-authorable response/selection action that has a defined agent-visible outcome across channels. That work exceeds this issue's narrow prompt-only repair boundary.
